extension.summary: Apple-TV-inspired interface for the ATV1 appliance
extension.description: Original, lightweight Kodi 17 skin in the spirit of the 2007 Apple TV: black gradient stage, white type, warm-gold focus. No Apple assets of any kind. Built for this appliance's reality - 1 GHz, software GL, kiosk: library browsing, playback, essential dialogs. On-device settings and text entry are deliberately out of scope; the coordinator manages, per ARCHITECTURE.
